Then the book moves far into the future. Gilead is no longer the present regime, and scholars are meeting at an academic conference in the year 2195.

description: Follows Offred’s constrained testimony, examining reproductive control, gendered power, memory, resistance, and the framing of historical evidence. Covers What happened before this room; A small city of rules; The forbidden room; The voice after the voice.
